friction.summary: Documented Lending-Devnet host dead; real hackathon devnet faucet ignores destination so Client.fundWallet fails
xrpl.js signLoanSetByCounterparty signs with STX prefix; rippled verifies counterparty sig with CPT prefix, so it is rejected
LoanBrokerSet returned tecNO_PERMISSION for the vault owner on public Devnet; succeeded on the hackathon devnet, so the code masked a network/build discrepancy
Interest assumed accrual at origination; this build (LendingProtocolV1_1) is cash basis, recognized on LoanPay
VaultWithdraw with a bare asset amount withdraws assets and leaves yield; redeeming all shares needs the share MPT amount

doc_questions.question: What is the current Lending hackathon devnet WebSocket host and what is its faucet contract?

Is lending interest accrual basis or cash basis on this network?
